Golden JBIG (T.85) streams produced by the reference encoder jbigkit:
`pbmtojbg -q -s 256 -m 0 -p 64 -o 3 in.pbm out.jbg`

Bitmaps are synthetic and regenerated by the tests (1 = ink, MSB first):
- blank_64x1:       all zero
- checker_4768x256: ((x/4)+(y/4)) % 2 == 0
- dot_9x3:          x == 4 && y == 1
- bars_4768x600:    (x/37) % 3 == 0 && (y/50) % 2 == 1   (not stored: 772 bytes, sha256 prefix fb8039065cfe1a15)
- diag_1000x300:    (x*7 + y*13) % 29 < 5   (not stored: 9774 bytes, sha256 prefix 3e2ccd8d9a3af46f)
